title: Checkpoint harness dispatch configuration
description: The run configuration sections an agent dispatch needs (Task 3 research log §§4, 10 and §12 T3-C; T3.5 H2 adds each role's effort). Planning accepts any object here; dispatch refuses until these sections are complete. Other sections are validated by run-config.schema.json.

kind.description: How the credential authenticates: a Console API key (default) or a Claude subscription OAuth token from `claude setup-token`.

provider.description: Reference to the environment variable holding the credential; never the credential itself.

retries.description: Protocol retries per step (T3-E): repeated production, admission, verification or review after a malformed result, a temporary fault or an interruption. The runner requires it; the adapter does not read it.

run_spend_usd.description: Optional spend limit of the whole run (T3.5 H3): an agent session starts only while reported costs, sessions of unknown cost and unresolved invocation allowances leave room for one more provider_spend_limit.usd.

provider_spend_limit.description: Hard spend limit per invocation. The provider checks its estimate only after each turn, so turn_reservation_usd is held back for the turn that crosses the limit.

model.description: A pinned Claude API model ID this adapter supports: the current lineup of https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview. Aliases such as claude-haiku-4-5 or claude-sonnet-4-5 resolve to the latest dated snapshot and are refused; adding an ID, with its EFFORT_LEVELS entry, is a reviewed change.

effort.description: The role's reasoning effort (T3.5 H2), sent with every request of its sessions. Dispatch also refuses a level the model does not accept (EFFORT_LEVELS in claude.ts); Claude Haiku 4.5 accepts none.

skill_digests.description: Expected SHA-256 of each selected skill's SKILL.md; a mismatch refuses dispatch.
